mapper.select: SELECT id, device_sn, shipment_time, package_no, contract_no, event_type, warranty_start_date, warranty_months, rma_no, related_device_sn, source_system, source_key, source_version, source_updated_at, synced_at, sync_status, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM ast_device_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND device_sn = #{query.deviceSn} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY shipment_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
